ChinaCheck is a free tool that helps short-term rental and serviced apartment operators check whether their property is ready for Chinese guests. It starts with your location to show how much Chinese-traveller demand your city has, then scores how ready your operation is to capture it, covering OTA visibility, payment acceptance, reviews, social media presence, language, on-property experience, and firewall accessibility. It is for hosts, property managers, and hospitality operators in Europe considering whether to invest in the Chinese inbound travel market. The tool runs entirely in the browser, requires no login or signup, and is free to use. ChinaCheck is part of the Operator Intelligence Suite, a set of free diagnostic tools by Roger Bisschoff, a commercial and distribution leader in European hospitality.
